Hi, I'm the data lead at City General Hospital. We've collected patient intake data for 2024, but it's a mess — there are duplicate patient entries, missing readings for some of the numeric fields (age and blood pressure measurements), and the column headers are all inconsistent (mixed case, spaces, etc.).

The file is located at `hospital_data/exports/raw/patient_intake_2024.csv`.

Could you clean it up for me? Specifically:
1. Remove any duplicate patient records.
2. Fill in the missing numeric measurements — use the median of each column so outliers don't skew things.
3. Make all column headers consistent and machine-friendly (lowercase, underscores instead of spaces).

Please save the final cleaned file as `clean_patient_intake_2024.csv`. Thank you!
